queue.title: Uploads
queue.partial: {failed} of {total} files couldn’t be uploaded. Retry just the failed files.
queue.interrupted: The upload was interrupted. Please try again.
queue.leaveWarning: Uploads are still in progress. If you leave, unfinished files won’t be saved.
queue.retryHint: The file could not be uploaded. Try again.

dropzone.prompt: Drag files here, or click to choose.
dropzone.heic: HEIC photos aren’t supported. On iPhone, go to Settings > Camera > Formats and choose “Most Compatible”, or convert the photo to JPG.
dropzone.tooMany: You can upload up to {max} files at once.
dropzone.renamedExt: Files with only a changed extension can’t be uploaded. Upload the file in its original format.
dropzone.metadataNotice: To protect privacy, photo metadata such as location isn’t stored.

download.denied: This file can’t be downloaded. You may not have access, or it’s no longer available.

confirm.cancel: Cancel the upload? Files in progress won’t be saved.

rejectReason.type: Rejected: the file type doesn’t match.
rejectReason.size: Rejected: the file is over the size limit.
rejectReason.pixels: Rejected: the image resolution is too high (max 40 megapixels).
